quoted.T1:11:0: "the smell came up. Earth smell, wet. And I nearly cried. … Like I was there and here at the same time. In the village and in England."
quoted.T1:3:0: "Excited. And a bit mad, I think. Slightly mad. … And I said no, full. I don't know why I said this. It came out of my mouth before I think."
quoted.T1:15:0: "I wanted one thing that is mine. Everything is for somebody. … And I thought, I want one thing that is mine, even if it's mostly mud."
